questions.explanation: 医生告诉作者患有焦虑症，但医生似乎并不觉得“担忧（worried）”，作者自己也同样没有感到担忧。后文提到作者离开时感到“解脱”，这与没有感到担忧相呼应。易错点：可能误选A(surprised)，但根据常理，确诊疾病通常对应的是担忧情绪，且与后文松了一口气的状态对比，worried更符合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(surprised)：语境句：She was surprised by the unexpected news of his arrival. 固定搭配：be surprised at/by, to one's surprise
B(worried)：语境句：Parents are often worried about their children's safety. 固定搭配：be worried about, look worried
C(pleased)：语境句：I am very pleased to inform you that you have won first prize. 固定搭配：be pleased with, be pleased to do
D(frightened)：语境句：The loud noise frightened the little girl into crying. 固定搭配：be frightened of, be frightened to do

questions.explanation: 因为困扰自己心理健康的谜团被解开，而且不需要治疗，所以作者离开时感受到了一种“解脱/轻松（relief）”。易错点：D(comfort)安慰，虽然也有积极意义，但在“心理重担落地”的语境中，relief（如释重负）最贴切。
questions.supplement:
A(relief)：语境句：Much to her relief, the exam was easier than she had expected. 固定搭配：a sense of relief, breathe a sigh of relief
B(concern)：语境句：The recent rise in crime has caused great concern among citizens. 固定搭配：express concern about, a matter of concern
C(freedom)：语境句：Education gives people the freedom to choose their own paths in life. 固定搭配：freedom of speech, religious freedom
D(comfort)：语境句：He found comfort in reading books after a long, tiring day. 固定搭配：bring comfort, in the comfort of

questions.explanation: 接下来的九个月里，作者在工作中“挣扎（struggled）”，并且处于焦虑的一团糟的状态中。搭配 struggle with (在……中挣扎，艰难应对) 符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(left)：语境句：He left the company to start his own business. 固定搭配：leave for, leave behind
B(started)：语境句：They started the project early to ensure it was finished on time. 固定搭配：start with, start doing/to do
C(struggled)：语境句：She struggled to balance her demanding career and family life. 固定搭配：struggle with, struggle to do
D(connected)：语境句：The new high-speed railway connected the two major cities. 固定搭配：connect A with/to B, stay connected

questions.explanation: 主宰作者生活的焦虑意味着作者无法“放松/不再思考（switch off）”。switch off 在这里引申为“让大脑休息，不去想烦心事”。易错点：break down 指“崩溃”，不符此处“无法停下来休息”的语境。
questions.supplement:
A(take off)：语境句：The plane will take off in twenty minutes, so please fasten your seatbelt. 固定搭配：take off, take time off
B(give in)：语境句：Despite the difficulties, she refused to give in and kept trying. 固定搭配：give in to, give up
C(break down)：语境句：His car broke down on the way to work, making him late. 固定搭配：break down, break out
D(switch off)：语境句：After a stressful day, I like to listen to music to switch off. 固定搭配：switch off, switch on

questions.explanation: 家人多年来一直硬拉着（dragged）作者去钓鱼，直到作者长大了能够“拒绝（refuse）”为止。drag的被动与无奈和后文的refuse形成合理的逻辑链。
questions.supplement:
A(volunteer)：语境句：Many students volunteer to help the elderly in their local community. 固定搭配：volunteer to do, volunteer for
B(refuse)：语境句：He refused to accept their offer because the salary was too low. 固定搭配：refuse to do, flatly refuse
C(stop)：语境句：The government has taken measures to stop pollution from factories. 固定搭配：stop doing, stop sb from doing
D(judge)：语境句：You shouldn't judge a person simply by their appearance. 固定搭配：judge by/from, judge a book by its cover

questions.explanation: 因为“我总是做不到/钓不到鱼（didn't make it）”，所以钓鱼对我来说总感觉像是一种“失败（failure）”。
questions.supplement:
A(anxiety)：语境句：Deep breathing can help reduce your anxiety before a speech. 固定搭配：suffer from anxiety, relieve anxiety
B(patience)：语境句：Teaching young children requires a great deal of patience. 固定搭配：have patience with, out of patience
C(failure)：语境句：Failure is the mother of success if you learn from your mistakes. 固定搭配：end in failure, experience failure
D(relaxation)：语境句：Yoga is a great form of relaxation for both body and mind. 固定搭配：relaxation techniques, mental relaxation

questions.explanation: 但这一次“不同了（different）”。从后文作者享受钓鱼的过程可以看出，这次的体验与以往的抗拒和失败截然不同。But 表转折。
questions.supplement:
A(different)：语境句：We need to look at this issue from a completely different angle. 固定搭配：be different from, a different approach
B(effective)：语境句：This medicine provides a highly effective treatment for the disease. 固定搭配：effective measures, highly effective
C(important)：语境句：It is important to maintain a healthy diet for overall well-being. 固定搭配：be important to/for, play an important role
D(challenging)：语境句：Climbing the mountain was the most challenging task he had ever faced. 固定搭配：a challenging job, face a challenge

questions.explanation: 作者发现自己沉浸在“抛（casting）”钓鱼线和看着假蝇在空中飞行的柔和节奏中。cast a line 是钓鱼的专业固定搭配，意为“抛线/甩钓竿”。
questions.supplement:
A(drawing)：语境句：She spent the whole afternoon drawing a portrait of her grandmother. 固定搭配：draw a conclusion, draw attention
B(managing)：语境句：He is good at managing a large team of diverse individuals. 固定搭配：manage to do, time management
C(checking)：语境句：Please remember checking your answers carefully before handing in the paper. 固定搭配：check in, check out
D(casting)：语境句：The old fisherman stood by the river, skillfully casting his net. 固定搭配：cast a net, cast a line

questions.explanation: 穿过森林去不同的水池，这里指的是在森林中的“散步/步行（walks）”。与后文的喝咖啡、吃午饭一样，都是放松活动的一部分。
questions.supplement:
A(insects)：语境句：Some insects play a crucial role in pollinating flowers. 固定搭配：insect bite, pest insect
B(walks)：语境句：We took long walks along the beach every evening during our vacation. 固定搭配：go for a walk, take a walk
C(risks)：语境句：Investing in the stock market involves certain financial risks. 固定搭配：take risks, at the risk of
D(experiences)：语境句：Traveling abroad can provide you with unforgettable cultural experiences. 固定搭配：gain experience, learn from experience

questions.explanation: 和家人共进午餐休息，为了“享受（enjoy）”美好时光。enjoy a good time 符合此处的温馨语境。
questions.supplement:
A(enjoy)：语境句：I hope you all enjoy your stay at our hotel. 固定搭配：enjoy doing, enjoy oneself
B(recall)：语境句：I can clearly recall the day we first met at the library. 固定搭配：recall doing, beyond recall
C(remember)：语境句：Please remember to turn off the lights before you leave. 固定搭配：remember to do, remember doing
D(choose)：语境句：Students are free to choose the topics for their final projects. 固定搭配：choose from, choose to do

questions.explanation: 钓到那条鱼让作者意识到，自己对自己的感受是拥有“控制权（control）”的。这治愈了作者前文提到被焦虑“支配（ruled）”的失控感。
questions.supplement:
A(doubt)：语境句：There is no doubt that technology has changed our way of life. 固定搭配：in doubt, beyond doubt
B(hope)：语境句：We hold out hope that they will find a solution to the problem soon. 固定搭配：in the hope of, give up hope
C(control)：语境句：The government took immediate action to bring the fire under control. 固定搭配：in control of, have control over
D(confidence)：语境句：The coach's encouragement helped him rebuild his confidence. 固定搭配：have confidence in, lack confidence

questions.explanation: 现在我拥有了某种东西，当生活处于“最艰难的（toughest）”时刻，它能给我带来希望。与困境抗衡产生希望，toughest最符合逻辑。
questions.supplement:
A(happiest)：语境句：Childhood is often considered the happiest time of a person's life. 固定搭配：the happiest moment, make sb happy
B(toughest)：语境句：We must stand united when facing the toughest challenges. 固定搭配：a tough decision, tough times
C(earliest)：语境句：This painting is one of his earliest works known to the public. 固定搭配：at one's earliest convenience, in the early days
D(best)：语境句：She tried her best to comfort the crying boy. 固定搭配：do one's best, make the best of

questions.explanation: 那条闪闪发光的小鱼“代表（represented）”了这一切（治愈、希望和对情绪的控制）。
questions.supplement:
A(proved)：语境句：The new theory proved to be correct after years of testing. 固定搭配：prove to be, prove oneself
B(changed)：语境句：The invention of the smartphone has completely changed our lives. 固定搭配：change one's mind, change for the better
C(replaced)：语境句：The old bridge was eventually replaced by a modern steel structure. 固定搭配：replace A with B, in place of
D(represented)：语境句：The red rose has long represented love and passion in poetry. 固定搭配：represent a country, be represented by

questions.explanation: 虽然我也做别的事情，但钓鱼是最能“完全（completely）”吸引我、让我投入的事情。
questions.supplement:
A(completely)：语境句：The house was completely destroyed by the terrible earthquake. 固定搭配：completely agree, completely different
B(potentially)：语境句：This new drug is potentially life-saving for cancer patients. 固定搭配：potentially dangerous, potential energy
C(directly)：语境句：Please contact the manager directly if you have any further questions. 固定搭配：directly involved, direct flight
D(wonderfully)：语境句：The party was wonderfully organized, and everyone had a great time. 固定搭配：wonderfully well, a wonderful experience

questions.explanation: 前文说到钓鱼“平息了周围的混乱（quiets the chaos）”，所以作者在寻找的是“内心的平静（peace）”。
questions.supplement:
A(life)：语境句：He devoted his entire life to the protection of wild animals. 固定搭配：bring to life, come to life
B(balance)：语境句：It is vital to strike a balance between work and leisure. 固定搭配：keep one's balance, out of balance
C(peace)：语境句：After years of war, the two nations finally signed a treaty of peace. 固定搭配：in peace, search for peace
D(joy)：语境句：To her great joy, she was accepted into her dream university. 固定搭配：to one's joy, jump for joy

section_2_word_form.passage:
In China, young people are exploring new side businesses. These include teaching Chinese, giving Chinese names to foreigners, and working as foreign language tour guides. This trend [56] (drive) by the increasing popularity of inbound(入境的) tourism.
A market for such side businesses targeting foreigners has emerged. For example, Xianyu, Alibaba's secondhand goods trading platform, has witnessed the growing popularity of different tour guide services. These services range from helping foreign couples plan honeymoons in China [57] guiding tourists to the Great Wall.
From the previous year until this mid-February, the number of projects related to tour guide services for foreigners and Chinese name-giving on Xianyu [58] (increase) by 98%. The ordering volume of these services jumped by 275%. Wu Pengfei, a Shanghai college student [59] (major) in Chinese teaching, has been a part-time tour guide since June last year. He says this job helps him earn more income, improve communication skills, and gain [60] (recognize).
Currently, China has about 660,000 qualified tour guides, with only 8.4% being foreign language guides. [61] inbound tourism grows, the shortage of such guides is becoming more obvious. Besides tour guiding, young Chinese are also offering name-giving services on rednote, [62] lifestyle platform. They choose names based on traditional Chinese culture and ancient poetry.
Since late 2023, China has been promoting inbound tourism and has introduced a series of visa-free(免签证的) [63] (policy) to many countries. Recently, China launched a visa-free policy for ASEAN (Association of Southeast Asian Nations) tour groups visiting Xishuangbanna in Yunnan. Malaysia and Thailand were among the top 10 countries of origin for inbound tourists during the Spring Festival. With [64] (culture) similarities and convenient transportation, more tourists from ASEAN countries are expected [65] (visit) China.

questions.explanation: 主语 This trend 与动词 drive 之间是被动关系，且此处陈述的是目前的普遍客观现象，故使用一般现在时的被动语态。is driven by 意为“被……所驱动”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(is driven)：语境句：The company's success is largely driven by its innovative marketing team. 固定搭配：be driven by, drive sb crazy。原词drive其它变形：driver(n. 司机), driving(adj. 驱动的), drove(v. 过去式), driven(v. 过去分词)

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配 range from A to B，意为“范围从A到B”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to)：语境句：The temperature today ranges from 15 to 25 degrees. 固定搭配：from ... to ..., range from ... to ...。其它搭配：to some extent, in addition to

questions.explanation: 时间状语为“From the previous year until this mid-February”，描述的是过去一段时间内发生的动作，且后文的 jumped 也使用了过去时，故填入一般过去时 increased。填 has increased 亦在某些语境下可接受，但由于有明确截止于过去的时间节点(until this mid-February)，一般过去时更为严谨。
questions.supplement: 正确形(increased)：语境句：The company's profits increased significantly last year. 固定搭配：increase by, increase to。原词increase其它变形：increasing(adj. 不断增加的), increasingly(adv. 日益地)

questions.explanation: 此处为非谓语动词作后置定语，修饰 a Shanghai college student。student 与 major in（主修）是主动关系，因此用现在分词 majoring。
questions.supplement: 正确形(majoring)：语境句：She is a college student majoring in international trade. 固定搭配：major in, a major problem。原词major其它变形：majority(n. 多数)

questions.explanation: 在动词 gain 后面需要接名词作宾语，表示“获得认可”，recognize 的名词形式是 recognition。
questions.supplement: 正确形(recognition)：语境句：His hard work finally gained him the recognition he deserved. 固定搭配：gain recognition, out of recognition。原词recognize其它变形：recognize(v. 认出；承认), recognizable(adj. 可辨认的)

questions.explanation: 分析句子结构可知，前后是两个完整的句子，需要填入连词。根据句意“随着入境游的增长，导游的短缺变得更加明显”，表示“随着”，应填入 As（注意首字母大写）。
questions.supplement: 正确形(As)：语境句：As time went by, he became more and more confident. 固定搭配：as well as, such as。其它用法：As...as possible, act as

questions.explanation: 逗号后的部分作 rednote (小红书) 的同位语，lifestyle platform 是可数名词单数，且泛指“一个”生活方式平台，故填不定冠词 a。
questions.supplement: 正确形(a)：语境句：He is a talented artist who paints beautiful landscapes. 固定搭配：a number of, as a result

questions.explanation: a series of 意为“一系列”，后接可数名词复数形式，故将 policy 变为复数 policies。
questions.supplement: 正确形(policies)：语境句：The government implemented several new economic policies. 固定搭配：foreign policy, policy maker。原词policy无明显词形变化，复数为policies。

questions.explanation: 修饰后面的名词 similarities 需要用形容词形式。culture 的形容词形式是 cultural，意为“文化的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(cultural)：语境句：The festival is an important cultural event for the local people. 固定搭配：cultural diversity, cultural exchange。原词culture其它变形：culture(n. 文化), culturally(adv. 文化上), cultured(adj. 有教养的)

questions.explanation: 考查句型 expect sb to do sth 的被动语态 be expected to do sth（被期望做某事/有望做某事），故填不定式 to visit。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to visit)：语境句：We expect him to visit our school next week. 固定搭配：expect to do, pay a visit to。原词visit其它变形：visitor(n. 游客), visiting(adj. 访问的)
